Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error in its final analysis by incorrectly identifying "Charleston" as the county seat of Sullivan County, New Hampshire. While the WebSurfer correctly retrieved information stating the county seat is "Charleston" in the first search result snippet, the Planner failed to verify this against the second, more authoritative snippet on the same page which explicitly stated: "The Town of Newport was chosen as the county seat as it remains to this day." By accepting the first contradictory snippet and ignoring the clarifying information from the same source, the Planner synthesized an incorrect final answer ("Charleston") instead of the correct one ("Newport"). This represents a failure in cross-referencing visible data and validating the extracted information before declaring the task complete.
